responseText:
Simple enough. Gather up some basic gathering tools, there are loaners all over camp. Head out onto the mountainside, maybe go south a bit. 

Whatever you do though, stay out of the mountain itself - or even the old waterways; I hear the Ironshod Minotaur have holed up in there, them and their wild Ramkin. Stay outside, under the open sky. Bring me back a small bundle of useful goods, and the tools are yours for keeps. Fair tide, right?

Proves you've got what it takes, and it helps restock our holds!
